sources.summary: Dezeen School Shows: a theatre in London designed for international students, refugees, asylum seekers, early-career workers and first-generation migrants is among projects from Middlesex University. Also featured is a charity-led music library and recording studio seeking to reduce youth crime and a civic-religious space aiming to counteract loneliness.
